The '''Knockout mine''' was a nonlethal device produced by [[Brennkeyes Syndicate]] for discreet personnel control. It gave users early warning of intruders and allowed them to focus on other tasks. Smaller and easier to conceal than lethal [[Mine/Legends|mines]], it was typically placed at head height and triggered by a [[Laser/Legends|laser]] [[Tripwire/Legends|tripwire]]. Upon detonation, it released a flash of light and a neuroparalytic agent that incapacitated any organic who inhaled it.<ref name="Desperate Allies" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Knockout mine was first mentioned in ''[[Desperate Allies]]'', a [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] supplementary sourcebook for the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying]]'' series that was published by [[Fantasy Flight Games]] in [[2015]].<ref name="Desperate Allies" />
